verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a native audit log: agent and CLI/MCP actions, including approvals and edits, 'land in the Ramp audit log' and 'every write operation lands in the customer's Ramp audit log automatically.' The MCP server also exposes an audits_logs:read scope. Policy enforcement and policy-grounded approval recommendations are documented, but the evidence describes the audit log mainly in the agent context and never shows a per-expense trail combining edits, approvals and policy-check outcomes. missing for 10: documentation of per-expense audit history covering human edits, approvals and policy-check results, audit-ready export or retention guarantees for external auditors, independent corroboration.
